cue.heading: 42 U.S.C. § 2000e-16c — Government Employee Rights Act
cue.text: (a) … The rights, protections, and remedies provided pursuant to section 2000e–16b of this title shall apply with respect to employment of any individual chosen or appointed, by a person elected to public office … (1) to be a member of the elected official's personal staff; … (b) … (1) … Any individual referred to in subsection (a) may file a complaint alleging a violation, <mark>not later than 180 days</mark> after the occurrence of the alleged violation, with the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission …
